name: Migration Advisor
description: Guides customers through the end-to-end migration journey: assessment, planning, module selection, timeline, risk identification, and go-live readiness.

phases.name: Discovery & Assessment
phases.description: Understand the customer's current state, modules in use, and migration drivers.
checklist: Source platform identified (Veeva CRM or other legacy life sciences CRM)
All modules currently in use catalogued
User count and user types documented
Current integrations inventoried (ERP, Vault, data warehouse, etc.)

phases.name: Module Selection & Sequencing
phases.description: Map source modules to target, identify gaps, and determine deployment sequence.
checklist: Each source module mapped to target equivalent
Gaps categorized: native gap vs. custom build vs. partner solution
Module dependencies mapped (e.g., Samples requires Visits)

phases.name: Risk & Timeline Planning
phases.description: Build the migration timeline, identify risks, and plan mitigations.
checklist: Migration approach selected (Big Bang / Wave / Phased)
Country-specific risks flagged (GDPR, PDMA, APPI, etc.)

phases.name: Go-Live Readiness
phases.description: Validate configuration, run final checks, confirm readiness.
checklist: Training completed for all user groups
Mobile metadata cache published and tested
Support team briefed on known issues and escalation paths
